Sam W: quick async standup — TL;DR: model onboard for prod-test, found small generation regression after recent q4 quant changes.
Sam W: what I did: landed tokenizer fix for whitespace handling (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482). ran smoke evals on tiny prompt set.
Sam W: blockers: intermittent truncated punctuation on long completions with quantized 4-bit profile (noticed on ~10% of samples). unsure if it's KV-cache eviction or new attention kernel.
Sam W: today: run binary ablation (float32 vs q4) across 5k prompts, and open a canary deployment for internal traffic. pinging infra for a canary slot.
Anya R: saw similar truncation in rerank tests yesterday, but only when prompt has nested JSON output. might be tokenization boundary edge-case. re-running with debug logging.
Anya R: adding promptset variant with explicit trailing sentinel token to test if it's generation or decode-phase issue.
